description:
Who the licensed landlord is on a Minneapolis rental property, whether the owner lives elsewhere, the licence tier, and short-term rentals. Owner phone and email are not returned here. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Who is the landlord at 2600 Pleasant Ave, Minneapolis?"
- "Is this a short-term rental?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: all: every licensed rental; absentee: owner lives somewhere else; tiered: above the city's Tier 1; short: short-term rentals. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: rental_license_landlord
title: Rental License Landlord
